summary: Tank with safe poke and huge teamfight CC. In lane he trades with W and Q, and his combos knock you up against terrain or his own pillar. He has low kill pressure alone, so true damage, %HP damage, and magic damage beat him.
threats: W (Bellows Breath) makes your target Brittle; his next CC on a Brittle target deals bonus %HP damage and lasts longer.
Q (Volcanic Rupture) slows and raises a pillar; E (Searing Charge) into the pillar or a wall knocks you up.
He's unstoppable during W; you can't interrupt it.
R (Call of the Forge God) at 5: a long-range ram that knocks up. His roam and teamfight engage are strong.

matchups.why: Vayne's W (Silver Bolts) deals true %HP damage, so Ornn's tank stats don't matter. She out-ranges and kites him, and Condemn can push him away when he charges in.
trading: Auto him whenever he walks up; he can't reach you without E.
Tumble (Q) away from his Q pillar before he E's into it.
Condemn him into a wall when he charges at you.
Step back out of W range; Brittle makes his next CC hurt.
matchups.early: Kite and farm. He can't kill you without his jungler, so poke freely.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R can knock you up from long range; watch for it with his jungler nearby.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and kite; take plates when he backs.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without E. Gank once he's used it.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. Crit and on-hit; Blade of the Ruined King-style %HP items.

matchups.why: Vitals deal true %HP damage, so Ornn's armor and HP don't save him. Riposte parries his E knockup or R ram and stuns him back, and he has no way to escape her Lunge.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for his E knockup or R ram.
Hit vitals, then back off before his W makes you Brittle.
Avoid fighting next to walls or his pillar.
Q (Lunge) away from his W flamethrower.
matchups.early: Trade on vitals from level 1 and push him under tower; he can't trade back.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R heal zone wins any extended fight; his R is a threat if his jungler follows.
matchups.wave: Slow-push, crash, and take plates while he's stuck under tower.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without E. Gank once he's used it.

matchups.why: Mordekaiser's damage is magic and his Realm of Death isolates Ornn from his jungler and steals his stats. Ornn's teamfight value disappears if he's losing every 1v1.
trading: Q (Obliterate) him when he walks up to farm.
E (Death's Grasp) pull him into your Q for burst.
Use W (Indestructible) to absorb his W poke.
Avoid fighting near walls or his pillar.
matchups.early: Trade freely; he can't kill you alone and his W poke is weak against your shield.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R removes him from the fight and steals his stats.
matchups.wave: Push and pressure his tower; he can't stop you.
matchups.jungle: Ward river; his R can turn a gank on your jungler.

matchups.why: Tank vs tank: neither champion can kill the other alone. Malphite's Q poke and Ornn's W poke trade evenly, so the lane is decided by jungle pressure and who roams better at 5.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) him when he walks up to farm.
Step back out of his W; Brittle makes his next CC hurt.
Avoid fighting near walls or his pillar.
Use your E (Ground Slam) to slow his attack speed if he trades.
matchups.early: Farm and Q poke. Neither of you can kill the other alone, so don't take bad trades.
matchups.spike: At 5 both R's set up ganks and roams; ward river and track where his R goes.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and roam once you both have R.
matchups.jungle: Your R plus your jungler kills him. Call when his E is down.
